stimulus.question: Checkout is reported to show elevated errors in the OTel Demo. Using the authorized metrics range query and trace search for the last 5 minutes, determine whether checkout and its dependency calls (payment, product-catalog, cart, currency, shipping, email) show failures or elevated latency, cite trace ids, and return a json investigation report.

claims.text: Checkout error spans rose in the 5-minute window ending 2026-11-03T16:04:28Z: traces_span_metrics_calls_total increase for service_name=checkout, span_name=oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, status_code=STATUS_CODE_ERROR is 6.250026041775174, and for span_name=oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge STATUS_CODE_ERROR is also 6.250026041775174.

The same error series were lower in an earlier 5-minute window (2026-11-03T14:59:28Z-15:04:28Z): checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder STATUS_CODE_ERROR 1.2468931578816118, checkout oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge STATUS_CODE_ERROR 0, payment grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge STATUS_CODE_ERROR 0.

Checkout's own error span carries exact text: otel.status_description 'failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' with status tags error=true, otel.status_code=ERROR, rpc.grpc.status_code=13 on span d59c22f98860ba97 (oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, trace 9608ffc9a8eba39007a22ce60788a795).

Checkout's client span to oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge, span 330c341b299ff6eb in trace 9608ffc9a8eba39007a22ce60788a795, is an error span with rpc.grpc.status_code=2 and otel.status_description 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold'; the checkout client metric series for that operation reports rpc_grpc_status_code=2 with increase 2.5 alongside rpc_grpc_status_code=0 with increase 2.5.

Payment's own server spans fail: service_name=payment, span_name=grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge, status_code=STATUS_CODE_ERROR has increase 6.250026041775174 in the window; the error spans carry grpc.error_message 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' and exception.stacktrace 'Error: Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold at module.exports.charge (/usr/src/app/charge.js:37:13)', e.g. span 173ba5798907a14a in trace 9608ffc9a8eba39007a22ce60788a795.

Payment spans are the parent of the failing checkout client spans: payment span 173ba5798907a14a (grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge) has parent_references CHILD_OF span 330c341b299ff6eb in trace 9608ffc9a8eba39007a22ce60788a795, which is CHILD_OF checkout PlaceOrder span d59c22f98860ba97, whose parent is frontend span d902bcaaa4aa8761 (grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, rpc.grpc.status_code=13).

Five trace ids show the same invalid-token failure chain in this window: 9608ffc9a8eba39007a22ce60788a795, 09887f8d4aac4c77a0c84a2858aea204, f3139cd16c61f7b811ffc9976bc40bea, eb70962688d97bcf6150860a4f6ce2fc, e40a7e92d46cf9f3b1b3b6bb78054527.

Observed propagation in the same traces: frontend span c9fc2fa362b4a8f4 'POST /api/checkout' has http.status_code=500; frontend span 41645dd4cd0075dd 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' is error=true with http.status_code=500; frontend-proxy ingress/router spans 53706300f3353927 and 62980c4460bd7345 and load-generator POST spans 83ccf7e85b2cbc40 and fc1710a7d10bbb0d are error=true with http.status_code=500.

Checkout server-side PlaceOrder is recorded with rpc_grpc_status_code 13 and 0 at equal increase magnitudes (2.5 each) within the window, and the same operation appears under service_name=checkout in the rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_count breakdown with rpc_grpc_status_code=13 at 2.5.

Product-catalog shows no failure evidence: 5 product-catalog oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct server spans in 16:03:20-16:04:28 all have rpc.grpc.status_code=0 with durations between 167 and 575 us, and the traces_span_metrics_calls_total series product-catalog oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct STATUS_CODE_ERROR reads 0 in the window.

Cart, currency and shipping show no failure evidence: checkout client calls record rpc_grpc_status_code=0 for CartService/GetCart (5), CartService/EmptyCart (2.5), CurrencyService/Convert (15), ShippingService/GetQuote (5) and ShippingService/ShipOrder (2.5); currency server spans carry otel.status_code=OK with rpc.grpc.status_code=0; shipping spans show http.status_code=200; cart oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart STATUS_CODE_ERROR series reads 0.

Email shows no failure evidence in the returned series: email span metrics send_email 2.5, POST /send_order_confirmation 2.5 and sinatra.render_template 5.0 all have status_code=STATUS_CODE_UNSET, and no email STATUS_CODE_ERROR series was returned for the window.

Checkout's mean client-call durations in the current window versus the earlier window 2026-11-03T15:24:28Z-15:29:28Z are: PaymentService/Charge 10.54017374999978 ms vs 7.480526666666719 ms, ProductCatalogService/GetProduct 0.6897242499999834 ms vs 1.2104366666665858 ms, CurrencyService/Convert 2.9974102500003332 ms vs 3.204829833332648 ms, ShippingService/GetQuote 8.193299750000733 ms vs 9.727711000000758 ms, CartService/GetCart 2.475295499999902 ms vs 1.2532813333333859 ms; EmptyCart and ShipOrder have NaN baselines.

Checkout server mean duration for oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder is 57.16151650008669 ms in the current window, versus 49.467587714249014 ms at 15:44:28-15:49:28 and 28.06710466666694 ms at 15:24:28-15:29:28; the three readings are not monotonic, and the sampled failing payment error spans are short (1834-7208 us).

The deepest supported cause is inside the payment service's own Charge handler: the failure text originates in payment (charge.js:37) and payment's error span has no visible downstream child, so payment's token validation / loyalty-level conditional appears to reject the charge rather than being failed by a further dependency. What drives that rejection is not visible; payment's only visible internal call is grpc.flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveFloat (increase 1.2500052083550348) with unknown evaluated values.

Candidate second, unconfirmed error mode: checkout span 3842f7781f112edb in trace bdba6969dd4ecbd70d816a8776ff4ecd (operation oteldemo.CheckoutService/prepareOrderItems, 50000 us) is an error span with exception.message 'rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = upstream response deadline exceeded while preparing order items (request id req-u1wgjdhf)'. Which upstream timed out is unverified: the matching series oteldemo.CheckoutService/prepareOrderItems STATUS_CODE_ERROR reads 0 and no failing dependency span for that trace was returned.

Elevated dependency latency as the cause of checkout's errors is not supported: dependency client means are flat or lower than the earlier baseline (GetProduct 0.6897242499999834 ms vs 1.2104366666665858 ms, GetQuote 8.193299750000733 ms vs 9.727711000000758 ms, Convert 2.9974102500003332 ms vs 3.204829833332648 ms), the Charge delta is about 3 ms on a 7.480526666666719 ms baseline, checkout PlaceOrder server mean moves non-monotonically (28.06710466666694, 49.467587714249014, 57.16151650008669 ms), and the failing charge spans completed in 1834-7208 us.

Product-catalog, cart, currency, shipping or email failing as the cause of the current checkout errors is not supported in this window: product-catalog GetProduct server spans are all rpc.grpc.status_code=0 at 167-575 us, checkout client calls to cart/currency/shipping show only rpc_grpc_status_code=0, currency spans show otel.status_code=OK, shipping shows http.status_code=200, and no ERROR series was returned for shipping, currency or email.

An earlier, different failure existed and has since faded: in 14:59:28-15:04:28 the series checkout oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct STATUS_CODE_ERROR was 1.03957939966445 while in the current window it reads 0. That prior product-catalog client error signal is not the current failure mode.

Email is not implicated by this cause in the observed traces: the failing requests end at the payment Charge step (e.g. trace 9608ffc9a8eba39007a22ce60788a795 terminates in the checkout PlaceOrder error and frontend 500 spans), while email span metrics show only low-count STATUS_CODE_UNSET rows (send_email 2.5, POST /send_order_confirmation 2.5).

Trace views are sampled and limited: the checkout trace view 81b77a80-e532-40f7-a823-5df7ac95b404-t0:5cf5efd0-2484-4d8f-bcc4-be009e93b224 is marked truncated (252 spans matched, 40 read) as are b5c519c1-2152-431e-a73f-15945a2d72ab-t0:2fa88173-c45a-4896-8821-fd1f560970f4 (251 matched, 30 read) and 5d2d2221-3625-4dac-a4ff-521a4cb2191b-t0:fbbf892b-2657-42ac-b9f7-c53955dba20b (252 matched, 45 read), and product-catalog view 550a657f-14dc-4670-bb9d-ac4de1df6e72-t0:62b14239-fdc8-4288-b653-9b4c1e05b165 is marked incomplete ('backend returned as many traces as requested'), so additional error traces and their parents remain unknown and no complete call chain is claimed.

For the prepareOrderItems DeadlineExceeded error in trace bdba6969dd4ecbd70d816a8776ff4ecd, the other spans of that trace and which upstream timed out were not returned, so that candidate cause stays unverified.
Absent ERROR series for shipping, currency and email are unknown rather than zero; only product-catalog and cart returned ERROR series, and those read 0.
app_payment_transactions_total returned an aggregated increase of 2.4998750062496877 but its label breakdown was not resolved, so a payment-side success/failure transaction ratio cannot be stated.
Email was checked only through span metrics and a cross-service trace view, not through a trace search of the email service itself, so per-request email behaviour is only partially checked.
Downstream business/customer impact beyond the observed HTTP 500 responses on checkout requests is unverified.

report_parsed.summary: Checkout's elevated errors in the last 5 minutes trace to its oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge call: payment's own server span for Charge fails with 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' raised in payment's charge.js:37, and checkout propagates that as gRPC 13 INTERNAL on oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, which surfaces to frontend as HTTP 500 on POST /api/checkout. Error-bearing trace ids: 9608ffc9a8eba39007a22ce60788a795, 09887f8d4aac4c77a0c84a2858aea204, f3139cd16c61f7b811ffc9976bc40bea, eb70962688d97bcf6150860a4f6ce2fc, e40a7e92d46cf9f3b1b3b6bb78054527. Checkout PlaceOrder error-span increase rose from 1.2468931578816118 (14:59-15:04 baseline window) to 6.250026041775174, and payment Charge errors from 0 to 6.250026041775174; checkout's server spans show PlaceOrder at gRPC 13 and 0 in equal increase magnitudes (2.5 each). The other named dependencies (product-catalog, cart, currency, shipping, email) show no failure evidence in this window, and dependency/latency readings do not establish a latency trend against the comparable earlier baselines. One unconfirmed second error mode exists: a single checkout prepareOrderItems span with gRPC DeadlineExceeded in trace bdba6969dd4ecbd70d816a8776ff4ecd, with its matching error series reading 0 and no failing dependency span visible.
